title: VRT: add decoding of more CIF1 fields to VITA 49 dissector
description:
## Description
Wireshark currently has a VRT (VITA radio transport protocol) dissector with context packet decoding but does not cover all fields in the VITA 49 spec. Add decoding of more CIF1 context packet fields using existing framework:
1. Aux frequency
1. Aux bandwidth
1. Discrete I/O (32-bit)
1. Discrete I/O (64-bit)
1. V49 spec compliance
1. Version and build code

## Links / references / protocol specifications

The VITA 49 spec is released by ANSI [(but requires purchase)](https://www.normadoc.com/english/ansi-vita-49-2-2017.html).

## Sample capture

[vrt_sample_capture_context_cif0_cif1_port_4991.pcap](/uploads/9b0e6ba8c0b835fe102c80e633f9fc07/vrt_sample_capture_context_cif0_cif1_port_4991.pcap)

Attached is a sample context packet (on VRT default port `4991`) which exercises all context fields currently supported by Wireshark as well as the new ones being added in this merge request. Note that this was used for test during development of the merge request, so some of the values are bogus (meant for testing & debugging purposes).

![wireshark_sceenshot_cif1](/uploads/bc9f4f143a5ab41512b7c09177674909/wireshark_sceenshot_cif1.png)
